verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs documents a speech-to-text convert API endpoint that transcribes an audio or video file, offers HTTP API and SDK access, and lists accepted formats (MP4, MOV, MP3, WAV, "and more") on its product page. The pack does not publish any file size or duration limits, so the story is only partly met. Missing for 10: published file size/duration limits, an exhaustive format list in the API reference, and independent hands-on corroboration of local file upload.

support.subject: As a developer, I can submit a local audio or video file for transcription through a documented API endpoint, with accepted formats and size limits published

citations.quote: Transcribe an audio or video file.
Upload audio or video in any format — MP4, MOV, MP3, WAV, and more.
HTTP and WebSocket support, official Python and Node.js SDKs.
